sourceChecks.text: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: モーセの子らの系譜で、ゲルショムとともに名が挙がります。後の記載ではその子孫が続きます。

sourceChecks.text: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 同一候補名の本文出現を前後の系譜・一覧文脈と照合した。

sourceChecks.text: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エリエゼルの子レハブヤから、その子イザヤ、ヨラム、ジクリ、シェロモテへと続く系譜が記されています。

excludedCandidateChecks.text: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
excludedCandidateChecks.reasonJa: 7:8のエリエゼルはベケルの子で、モーセの子とは別人です。

excludedCandidateChecks.text: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
excludedCandidateChecks.reasonJa: 15:24のエリエゼルは祭司として箱の前でラッパを吹く人物で、モーセの子とは別人です。

excludedCandidateChecks.text: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;
excludedCandidateChecks.reasonJa: 27:16のエリエゼルはルベンの長でジクリの子、別人です。
